text: わしの　やったポケモンは…ほう　だいぶ　なついた　みたいだな？

structure.jp: わしの　やったポケモンは…
だいぶ　なついた　みたいだな？
structure.en: it seems to have grown quite attached, hasn't it?

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしの　やったポケモン
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in やった sits right before ポケモン and describes it. Inside such a phrase の can stand in for が, the doer. わしの　やったポケモン = 'the Pokémon I gave you'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: なついた　みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ after a verb means 'it looks like', a casual guess from what you see. なついた　みたいだ = 'it seems to have grown attached'.
